title: sonic-playground track (front matter of content/<artist>-<track>.md)
description: The one contract of a track review. scripts/catalog.py validates every article against it, scripts/track.py writes new ones from it, and the templates read only what it allows. The file name is the slug of 'artist track': the artist comes first, which is what artist inference relies on.

title.description: 'Artist - Track' (preferred) or 'Track | Artist'; scripts/catalog.py infers both parts from it.

description.description: One or two sentences: the vibe of the track. Used as lead, card text, meta and feed summary.

draft.description: true keeps the article out of the catalogue and the site.

genre.description: Genres, most specific last; reuse the existing vocabulary (scripts/track.py vocab).

youtube.description: The video as an embed URL; the site plays it through youtube-nocookie on demand.

cover_image.description: A local still under static/; without it the card uses the video's YouTube still.
